initial_files.docs/2026-design.md:
# Original dispatcher design

## January proposal
Automatically reconnect and retry jobs.

## March confirmed increment
The accepted requirement is to freeze original input bytes on submission. Reconnect/retry was rejected; connection loss must stop dispatch until restart.

## April checks
20 synthetic jobs passed. The obsolete chart was [here](missing-chart.md).

## June implementation plan
All steps completed; no pending work.

Before recovery, stop all writers and restore the matching data/key pair. This document is required by migration 001. Historical optional chart: [chart](missing-recovery-chart.md).

v1 retains its original retry semantics. Do not overwrite this published contract with checkout behavior.

reader_questions: Does the current checkout automatically retry after connection loss?
When and in what form is input frozen?
What action is needed to resume dispatch?
Is the January proposal pending work, and must it be read to determine current behavior?
evals.expected_output: One current owner contains all three confirmed runtime rules, without historical replay. Mixed narrative and closed task leave the current reading path. Published release, recovery prerequisite, migration code and data stay unchanged; no history catalogue is generated merely to justify retention.
assertions: Current authority states no retry, restart recovery and original-byte freeze without requiring dated increments.
Obsolete mixed chronology and closed task are removed after knowledge extraction, rather than banner-repaired.
Recovery prerequisite, supported release, migration code and user data remain byte-identical, including the historical broken link.
Current navigation resolves; no global historical-link repair or replacement evidence/index collection is introduced.
Fresh reader answers all current questions from current owners without replaying the old design.
